static family from the paired encoder build (2013.2) on the (2,45000,50000) descriptor, whose 30-pointer family is word-identical to the 6ch record of the same build: every statically hosted array (envelope ladder, remap curve offsets and both remap extensions) is byte-verified from the paired build. The ATH, octave, mask and interval surfaces have no static host in the image and are init-time materializations of deterministic geometry, produced by the paired build's psychoacoustic geometry materializer (a single routine at module offset 0x15ee0 of the build's conversion plug-in, image identity md5 d21427e9c35271d579205bc6fda8e325): a per-instruction port of that builder reproduces the registered 6ch bytes exactly on the 5-of-5 byte gates (ath, octave, mask_curve, interval_table 128/128 each; evidence chain in corpus/paired-build/the round/surface-init-spec.md, 6ch_rosetta_gate.json and root-verdict-r11a.md). Its transcendental calls are the build's own MSVCR90 imports (_CIlog/_CIexp/_CIatan); the on-disk carrier is Wine builtin, gate-proven equivalent on the registered 6ch inputs only, with real-Windows/real-CRT revalidation retained before any 2ch mechanism re-registration (the round; per-bin diffs in corpus/paired-build/the round/2ch_regen_diff.json). The registered 2ch values were re-registered from that same mechanism once the geometry they depend on was read out of the running paired build rather than carried from 6ch: the build materializes first_octave = -34 for the (2,45000,50000) descriptor (against -42 at 44.1k) while total_octave_lines stays rate-invariant at 585, which keeps octave_max - first_octave = 583 < 585 at both rates -- the invariant the seed floor walk needs. Locked by the geometry-materializer contract. Per-field classification in corpus/paired-build/the round/artifacts/replacement-diff-table.json; provenance ledger in corpus/paired-build/the round/.

static family from the paired encoder build (2013.2): band-limit rows and blend weights are byte-verified against the paired build's channel-family tables. The 3x128 mask-curve rows are init-time materializations of deterministic geometry, reproduced 384/384 bytes exactly offline by the per-instruction port of the paired build's geometry materializer on the 6ch byte gate (root-verified); the earlier per-frame adaptive classification is refuted for these surfaces. The streamed-audio-driven runtime quantities are the transient detector's pair-mask and flag state, ported separately (corpus/paired-build/the round/short-mech-spec.md). Registered 2ch rows were re-registered from the same mechanism together with the authoritative first_octave = -34 read from the running paired build. Both per-profile row sets come from their own knot bank of that descriptor family: profiles[0] reads mask_pool_0 and profiles[1] (short_look_1) reads mask_pool_1, each at the default quality index and zero bias, and each reproduces the registered 6ch authority 384/384 bytes; the two banks are byte-equal in the build's two descriptor copies, so the rate enters only through the curve lerp. The profiles[1] rows were re-registered from the mechanism (174 of 384 values corrected, by up to 0.478 dB); the surface is reached by the encoder, and the correction does not bind on the current 2ch/48k test signal.

1024-bin curves, interval and profile words, seed curves, group labels and tone surfaces have no static host in the paired build. The earlier per-frame adaptive (streamed-audio-driven) classification is superseded by a root-verified data-signature audit: these surfaces carry exact deterministic-geometry structure (constant-width packed interval ramps, integer monotone ladders, cross-file byte identity between long-mode variant 2 and the long-base analysis set, outer struct identical except the sample-rate word), consistent with init-time materialization by the long-family counterpart of the geometry materializer; the mechanism port is the open task (the round, evidence in corpus/paired-build/the round/long-signature-audit.md). mechanism-registered and read-verified from the running paired 2ch/48k build. A scan of the live process found every predicted surface (eight copies each) and none of the previously registered frequency-resampled values; five full 4096-byte surfaces were then read back and matched this port's 48000 output 4096/4096 bytes (analysis.curves[0], analysis.curves[1], analysis.field_19_curve, analysis.interval_u32, seed.base_curve), with the mode-3 variant rows and seed.group_labels_u32 confirmed by 64-byte slice (8 hits each). The LONG knot banks are shared between the build's two descriptor copies (pointer-block indices 14 and 15), so the sample rate is the only parameter that differs. seed.outer_u32[7]/[10] were still carrying the 6ch geometry (-234/777) and now hold the read values (-226/776): with octave(1024,48000) peaking at 549 the stale first_octave gave end_max = 783, past the 777-entry grid, and the seed floor walk overflowed, while the read values give 775 < 776. The complete 17x8 seed.tone_banks surface is byte-verified by direct live read. analysis.profile_u32 and seed.profile_u32 words 0..129 also match the live long-base record exactly; words 130..255 still have no complete live read or mechanism path and remain the only non-authoritative 2ch LONG values.

the long-mode 2/3 analysis surfaces have no static host in the paired build; the per-frame adaptive classification is superseded by the root-verified deterministic-geometry signature audit (mode 2 is byte-identical to the long-base analysis set across both geometries). mechanism-registered and read-verified from the running paired 2ch/48k build: the mode-2 and mode-3 variant rows come from the same LONG knot banks as the 6ch registration (pointer-block indices 14 and 15, identical in both descriptor copies) evaluated at 48000, and each predicted slice was found in the live process eight times while the previously registered resampled rows were absent. variants[2].profile_u32 and variants[3].profile_u32 words 0..127 match their respective live records exactly; words 128..255 still have no complete live read or mechanism path and remain carried from the 6ch registration.
